about: Every Hinagata option by path (as in DEFAULTS, src/options.js). Generated by tools/schema.mjs from src/schema.js: edit those, not this file.

fields.type: number | boolean | color (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa) | enum | image (path or data URL) | json (arrays, or any shape)
fields.soft: the range is a guess from the default; values outside it are allowed
fields.reverse: a slider shows the larger value on the left (lower is longer)
fields.tier: main = shown in the editor / advanced = folded (fine-tuning)
fields.cost: what a change rebuilds: instant | paint (materials or painted attributes) | hair | clothes | body (body, clothes and hair)
fields.apply: the avatar method that applies it without a rebuild, or null
fields.alsoShapes: an instant change that also moves a shape on the next build
fields.order: main values: their place in the editor's panels
fields.when: { path: value }: the value only matters when those other values are set so ("*set": anything but null)

help.ja: [{ kind, bone, at, n, spin, size, color, mirror }] 体に付ける小物。kind: leaf(葉っぱ) / gem(宝石) / flower(花) / star(星) / ball(玉) / ribbon(リボン) / button(ボタン) / anchor(いかり) / band(輪: 腕輪・足首・首)。bone の上に乗る。at: 頭なら頭の座標、ほかは骨の関節からのずれ。n: 向き(表面の向き)。spin: 向きのまわりの回転(度)。size: 大きさ(m、band は輪の太さ)。mirror: 反対側にも
help.en: [{ kind, bone, at, n, spin, size, color, mirror }] small pieces on the body. kind: leaf / gem / flower / star / ball / ribbon (a bow) / button / anchor / band (a ring around the limb: bracelet, anklet, choker), riding on bone. at: head space for the head, else the offset from the bone's joint. n: the way it faces (the surface's normal). spin: turned around n (degrees). size: m (a band: how thick the ring is). mirror: on the other side too

help.ja: この1色から虹彩のグラデーションを作る
help.en: The iris gradient is made from this one color

help.ja: 房と房が重なるところの線。前髪だけ: 前髪(と描いた房)は線あり、後ろ髪・テールは外側の縁だけ。なし: 髪はどこも外側の縁(と顔に掛かるところ)だけ
help.en: the lines where locks lie over each other. Bangs only: the bangs (and drawn locks) keep them, the back hair and tails only along their outer edge. None: the whole hair only along its outer edge (and over the face)

help.ja: 2 = 光と影だけ(すっきり) / 3 = 中間の色つき
help.en: 2 = light and shadow only (clean) / 3 = with a mid tone

help.ja: 影の境目を大きな形にそわせる(0 = メッシュの凹凸のまま)
help.en: how much the shadow follows the big shapes instead of small bumps (0 = the mesh as is)

help.ja: 輪郭のふちを明るく光らせる
help.en: a bright edge along the outline

help.ja: 太さはそのままで脚を伸ばす(倍)。頭を小さくするのと合わせると頭身が上がる
help.en: lengthens the legs, keeping their width (×). With a smaller head, the figure gets more heads tall

help.ja: 太さはそのままで胴を伸ばす(倍)。腕の長さを決めていなければ腕も少し長くなる
help.en: lengthens the torso, keeping its width (×). Unless the arm length is set, the arms get a little longer too

help.ja: 胴を伸ばすとき胸が受け持つ割合。0 = 胸はそのまま(おなか・腰が伸びる)、1 = 胴の中で同じだけ伸びる(胸が縦長になる)
help.en: the chest's share when the torso lengthens. 0 = the chest keeps its shape (the waist and belly lengthen), 1 = the whole torso evenly (the chest goes long)

help.ja: 腕の長さ(倍)。決めると腕は胴といっしょに伸びず、形のまま肩についていく(手が縦に伸びない)。null = 胴といっしょに伸びる(ちび)。高頭身は 1.45 で指先が太ももの上のほうに届く
help.en: the arms' length (×). Set, the arms don't stretch with the torso: they keep their shape and ride on the shoulder (the hands don't get stretched). null = they stretch with the torso (chibi). The tall types: 1.45, the fingertips reaching the upper thigh

help.ja: 手首を中心に(倍)
help.en: around the wrist (×)

help.ja: 足首を中心に、足の裏は床のまま(倍)。靴も合わせて変わる
help.en: around the ankle, the sole kept on the floor (×); shoes follow

help.ja: 肩の関節を外へ(倍)。肩の肉と、首から肩への線・胸もいっしょに広がる
help.en: moves the shoulder joints out (×); the shoulders' flesh, the line from the neck and the chest widen with them
the tall types: 0.7 (about 5 heads, 2026-10-06); the chibi 0.9

help.ja: 口から下だけを縦にのばす(倍)。鼻と口と目はそのまま。あごをとがらせても、ほおがこけない
help.en: only the face under the mouth gets longer (×); the nose, mouth and eyes stay. Room for a pointed chin without hollow cheeks

help.ja: 眉より上の頭を縦に縮める・のばす(倍)。髪・結び髪・頭のアクセサリーもいっしょに。顔(眉より下)はそのまま
help.en: the head above the brows squashed or stretched up (×), with its hair, tails and what is put on the head; the face under the brows stays

help.ja: 強くするときは、くびれの縦の長さ(くわしい設定の waist › height)も長くすると、なめらかな S 字になる
help.en: for a strong waist, make it longer too (waist › height, in the fine-tuning) for a smooth S line

help.ja: null = 太ももと同じ
help.en: null = same as the thigh

help.ja: 胴・脚・手足を高頭身の大人の形で作る(6頭身くらい向け)。服の高さも体に合わせる。オフ = いままでの体
help.en: the torso, legs, hands and feet made in a grown-up's shape (for about 6 heads); the clothes' heights follow it. Off = the body as before

help.ja: 足首から脚の付け根までの、どこにひざが来るか(0.53 = いままで)。小さいほどすねが短い
help.en: where the knee is between the ankle and the hip joint (0.53 = as before); less is a shorter shin

help.ja: 股関節の、体の真ん中からの距離。小さいと太ももの付け根が寄って、腰の横が四角く張り出さない(原神のような脚)。腰の幅・太ももの付け根の太さと合わせて
help.en: the hip joints' distance from the middle. Smaller: the thighs meet at the top and the hips don't jut out square (legs like Genshin's). Adjust with the hips' width and the thighs' top

help.ja: 足首の、体の真ん中からの距離
help.en: the ankles' distance from the middle

help.ja: 膝の、体の真ん中からの距離。付け根より小さいと、脚が膝へ向かって内側へ寄る
help.en: the knees' distance from the middle. Under the hips', the legs close in toward the knees

help.ja: 胸のふくらみの、体の真ん中からの距離(m)。空 = 胸板から決める
help.en: each side's distance from the middle (m); empty = from the chest

help.en: lifts the head (m)

help.en: how much the neck thins with a smaller head. 0 = the same whatever the head

help.ja: 眼窩(目のくぼみと、こめかみへの帯)を目の真ん中を中心に大きく・小さく(倍)。目を小さくするときに合わせて小さくすると、眼窩が輪郭に出ない

help.ja: 顔の横を、輪郭の角度を変えずに外へずらす(m、頭の座標)。目・鼻・口とあごの先はそのまま。倍率で広げると、ほおほど外へ出て輪郭が上へ開く
